title: Standard Service Package (SSP)
description: One SSP with its clinical sub-variants and bundled contents. Generated from the SSP CSV exports.

id.description: Five character SSP grouper ID, e.g. AE02Z. Billed in place of the anchor code.

description.description: Consumer-facing plain text description of the SSP.

type.description: Level of care the package is structured at.

code.description: item_service: the anchor code only. encounter: anchor code plus ancillary line items. episode: multi-visit journey.

label.description: Label as it appears in the source CSV.

disease_area.description: Clinical grouping used in the SSP library coverage table, e.g. Musculoskeletal.

shoppability.description: Turquoise Shoppability score: how far a patient can plan or shop for the service.

apc.description: CMS Ambulatory Payment Classification the SSP crosswalks to. Outpatient SSPs only; null when missing.

ms_drg.description: CMS MS-DRG the SSP crosswalks to. Inpatient SSPs only.

anchor_codes.description: Every code that rolls into this SSP: anchors from the contents export plus every sub-variant's anchor codes. Use this (or code_index.json) to map a billed code to an SSP.

sub_variants.description: Complexity tiers inside the SSP. Empty when the SSP has no sub-variants.

id.description: Five character sub-variant ID, e.g. AE022. Shares its first four characters with the SSP ID.

name.description: Consumer-facing sub-variant name, e.g. Moderate complexity (new or established).

anchor_codes.description: Codes that place a claim in this sub-variant. May be empty in the current export.

contents.description: Services, codes and fees billed in association with the anchor code, as exported.

fee_type.description: Claim the line is billed on.

is_anchor.description: Anchor flag as exported. The current export only sets it on facility lines; see anchor_codes for the full set.

association_rate.description: Share of historical anchor claims that included this line, 0 to 1. Null when not exported (MS-DRG anchors).

files.description: CSV exports the record was built from.

code_type.description: Code system of a billing code.
